NOT IN SCOPE: daemon persistence, plan.propose wiring, approval.decide, context readers, or specs/NodeMission ingestion. Consumer: the core publication task filed after this task and the criteria sibling will expose the symbol, then the daemon planning-authority envelope will consume it.
definitionOfDone: A focused production module defines a closed, versioned, deeply frozen PlanRevision body with ordered typed steps, affected node/criterion ids, verification refs, author/lineage, graph binding, approval state, and no execution affordance.

Canonical encode/decode and server-computed digest reject malformed, noncanonical, unsupported-version, duplicate, over-limit, and digest-mismatch inputs with exact stable code and layer; no caller-supplied digest gains authority.
Tests include at least one nonempty real plan control and a positive-count hostile/mutation table that changes every authoritative field and pins the production code/layer.
Every production source is <=250 physical lines, each bridge is byte-exact LF, and no daemon/store/wire surface is changed.
`pnpm --filter @moe/core test` exits 0 and prints nonzero Test Files and Tests counts; completion records the publication-task consumer id.
